# Your Office Space

> Newcastle-based commercial property and workplace support. Tenant representation and commercial buying operate in NSW. YOS provides client-side FitOut project management, furniture support and selected workplace services. Appointed contractors perform construction. Cleaning is limited to Newcastle CBD and Lake Macquarie.

## Services
- [Tenant representation](https://www.yourofficespace.au/tenant-rep): Search, property comparison and commercial negotiation support for tenants.
- [Commercial buyers agency](https://www.yourofficespace.au/buyers-agency): Buyer-side commercial property support.
- [Office FitOut](https://www.yourofficespace.au/office-fitout): Client-side project coordination and scope planning.
- [Office furniture](https://www.yourofficespace.au/furniture): Furniture briefs, product selection and installation coordination.
- [Commercial cleaning](https://www.yourofficespace.au/cleaning): Workplace cleaning in Newcastle CBD and Lake Macquarie.

## Guides and planning tools
- [Resources](https://www.yourofficespace.au/resources): Planning tools, guides and published client case studies. Tool results depend on the stated inputs and assumptions.
- [Articles](https://www.yourofficespace.au/blog): Commercial property and workplace planning guides. Refer to each article's publication date and sources.
- [Client case studies](https://www.yourofficespace.au/case-studies): Approved client stories and documented outcomes.
- [Recovery Station](https://www.yourofficespace.au/case-studies/recovery-station-east-maitland-tenant-representation): Clinical and office tenancy search in East Maitland.
